mnemonics.label: Points trick (Config vs Context)
mnemonics.html: Config = One, Context = Common = ServletConfig per servlet; ServletContext shared by the whole app

answer_html:
Definition

The javax.servlet package contains the general (protocol-independent) interfaces and classes of the Servlet API.

Interface / ClassUse
ServletMain interface: init(), service(), destroy()
ServletRequestRead client data (getParameter)
ServletResponseSend response (getWriter, setContentType)
ServletConfigConfig of one servlet (getInitParameter)
ServletContextShared info for the whole web app
RequestDispatcherforward() / include() to other resources
GenericServletAbstract class implementing Servlet
ServletExceptionError from a servlet
ServletInputStream / OutputStreamBinary data
